sql_operations.label: initial native runner epochs
inject one pending fixture command anchored to completed A run
sql_operations.statement:
BEGIN;
    WITH added AS (INSERT INTO runner_commands(id,corp_id,runner_id,run_id,command_kind,payload,idempotency_key)
      SELECT 'f619d67a-3916-4a73-b605-3872800dce4a'::uuid,r.corp_id,r.runner_id,r.id,'circuit_breaker',
        '{"test_owned":true,"issue":172,"fault":"deliberately omitted breaker stage"}'::jsonb,'issue172-native-fault-f619d67a-3916-4a73-b605-3872800dce4a'
      FROM runs r JOIN tasks t ON t.id=r.task_id JOIN missions m ON m.id=t.mission_id
      WHERE r.id='510df2ab-00e3-4258-ae6c-0276127b8716'::uuid AND r.corp_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid AND r.runner_id='a-issue172-native-qa'
        AND r.status='completed' AND m.id='9702bd07-5e32-4318-8473-c1ce2fdc611a'::uuid AND m.requested_by='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011'::uuid
        AND r.verification_status='passed' AND r.deliverable_sha256 IS NOT NULL
      RETURNING id,corp_id,runner_id,run_id,command_kind,payload,idempotency_key,status,created_at,dispatched_at,failed_at,failure_detail)
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'command',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(added))->0) FROM added;
    COMMIT;

sql_operations.label: make only the browser-saved B mission eligible without publishing a wakeup
sql_operations.statement:
BEGIN;
    WITH before AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT m.id,m.corp_id,m.status,m.requested_by,t.id AS task_id,t.status AS task_status,t.contract,t.verification_policy,
        t.assigned_agent_id,t.attempt_count,t.max_attempts,a.status AS agent_status,a.retired_at
      FROM missions m JOIN tasks t ON t.mission_id=m.id JOIN agents a ON a.id=t.assigned_agent_id
      WHERE m.id='b8c19c0a-a36d-4526-919a-c64cfa01ddb2'::uuid AND m.corp_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid AND m.requested_by='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011'::uuid
        AND m.status='ready' AND t.id='1c7160d0-d054-435e-af68-10c9bb6631c7'::uuid AND t.status IN ('pending','ready') AND t.attempt_count=0
        AND t.max_attempts>=1 AND a.status='idle' AND a.retired_at IS NULL
        AND t.contract->>'source_repository'='ecorp-fixture/issue172-b' AND t.contract->>'source_base_commit'='bc00cde6f2925b588e5f080597fcf3fd028d1d29'
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE task_id=t.id)
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_dependencies WHERE task_id=t.id) FOR UPDATE OF m,t,a),
    changed AS (UPDATE missions m SET status='running',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM before b WHERE m.id=b.id RETURNING m.id,m.status,m.updated_at)
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',(SELECT count(*) FROM changed),'before',(SELECT to_jsonb(b) FROM before b),
      'after',(SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM changed c),'event_seq',coalesce((SELECT max(seq) FROM events WHERE corp_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),0),
      'transaction_at',clock_timestamp(),'simulation','fixture-only ready-to-running transition; no browser launch or lifecycle publication');
    COMMIT;
